notes:
I found no toddler underwater basket weaving anywhere. The basket-weaving classes my search turned up were adult or teen workshops in other places, and none were in Halton Hills or for toddlers. The closest real thing a toddler can do is water play with a parent, which the Town of Halton Hills runs as Parent & Tot swim lessons.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Parent & Tot 1/2/3 swim lessons, Town of Halton Hills (Acton Lion's Indoor Pool and Gellert Community Centre)",
      "age_fit": "Parent and Tot 2: 12 to 24 months; Parent and Tot 3: 2 to 3 years old",
      "when": "Acton fall schedule runs Saturday October 3 to Thursday December 3, 2026; Gellert evening and weekend lessons run October 3 to December 7, 2026",
      "price": "$86.22 for 9 lessons (30 minute lesson) at Acton",
      "source_name": "Town of Halton Hills"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Age:** 
Parent and Tot 2 is for 12 to 24 months and Parent and Tot 3 is for 2 to 3 years old.
 
Children 0-6 must have a parent or guardian aged 14 or older accompany them into the water.

- **Acton:** 
The Acton fall schedule runs Saturday October 3 to Thursday December 3, 2026, and Parent & Tot to Swimmer 3 is $86.22 for 9 lessons (30 minute lesson).

- **Gellert:** 
Fall 2026 evening and weekend lessons run Saturday, October 3 to Monday December 7, 2026.

- **Not found:** I did not pin down the exact Parent & Tot class day and time for fall, or the registration date. Those are on the town's registration page.
- **Drop-in option:** The town also runs a drop-in Parent & Tot swim. The only dates I found were 
Tuesdays or Thursdays from 10:00-10:30 a.m., March 24 to June 25
, which is spring 2026. I did not see fall dates.
